T: One mouse. Two brothers. Plenty of cheese.
D: Two brothers inherit a run-down mansion and a tiny mouse who refuses to leave.
P: Serve the snacks when the brothers set their first mouse trap with cheese.
S: String cheese, aged cheddar, gouda and blue with crackers, grapes and nuts

String cheese, aged cheddar, gouda and blue cheese on a board with crackers, grapes and a little bowl of nuts, enough to tempt any mouse. Arrange string cheese, wedges of aged cheddar, gouda and blue cheese on a wooden board. Add water crackers, a bunch of green grapes and a little bowl of nuts. Leave one small wedge of cheese on its own at the edge of the board as bait.
Cheddar and gruyere grilled cheese cut in wedges with holes poked in the top
Little toasties of cheddar and gruyère on buttered bread, grilled until golden and cut into wedge shapes with holes poked in the top.

Tangles of spaghetti bound with egg, parmesan and parsley, fried into crisp golden nests and served with a smoky tomato and basil dipping sauce. Cook 200g spaghetti, drain and cool. Toss with 3 beaten eggs, 60g grated parmesan, chopped parsley and pepper. Heat 1cm oil in a frying pan and drop in twisted forkfuls, flattening slightly. Fry 2 minutes a side until crisp and golden. Simmer 300ml passata with a garlic clove, half a tsp smoked paprika and basil for 10 minutes to dip.
M: Chicken breast stuffed with spinach and ricotta, mushroom cream sauce, potato gratin
Chicken breasts stuffed with spinach and ricotta, seared and roasted at 200C for 20 minutes, with a creamy mushroom sauce and potato gratin.
LaRue mansion pork loin with crackling
getting the old LaRue mansion ready for auction

Pork loin rolled with sage and garlic, roasted with apples and potatoes until the crackling shatters, with a sharp apple and mustard sauce. Score the skin of a 1.5kg rolled pork loin, rub with salt and dry in the fridge for an hour. Push sage leaves and garlic slivers into the meat. Roast at 240C for 25 minutes, then at 180C for 1 hour with 1kg halved potatoes and 3 quartered apples. Simmer 2 more chopped apples with sugar and water until soft, then stir in 1 tsp Dijon. Rest the pork 10 minutes and carve.
W: Baked cream cheese cheesecake on a cookie crust, spread with lemon curd

Baked vanilla cheesecake on a biscuit base, baked at 160C for 50 minutes, cooled in the oven, with lemon curd. Crush 250g sweet biscuits with 100g melted butter and press into a tin. Beat 500g cream cheese with 150g sugar, then beat in 3 eggs. Pour over and bake at 160C for 50 minutes, then cool in the oven. Spread with lemon curd before serving.
K: Honey vanilla milkshakes in small glasses, with a cheese cracker on each rim

Cold milk blended thick with vanilla ice cream, honey and a pinch of cinnamon, served in small glasses with a tiny cheese biscuit on the rim. Put 500ml cold milk, 4 scoops vanilla ice cream, 2 tbsp honey and a pinch of cinnamon in a blender. Blend until thick and frothy. Pour into eight small glasses so everyone gets two little ones. Cut a small slit in 8 round cheese biscuits and perch one on the rim of each glass.

note.text: I cooked for important people once, Lars, and the mouse still got to the cheese plate before us. Eat what is left.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours ahead, cover and keep cool

steps.text: Cut the cheddar, gouda and blue cheese into wedges.
Arrange the cheeses and string cheese on a wooden board with the crackers, grapes and a little bowl of nuts.
Leave one small wedge of cheese on its own at the edge as bait.
Butter the bread on the outside and fill with the cheddar and gruyere.
Cook in a pan until golden and melting on both sides.
Cut each into cheese-shaped wedges and poke a few holes in the top with a chopstick like cartoon cheese.

dishes.make_ahead: Gratin up to 1 day, reheat gently

steps.text: Wilt the spinach, squeeze dry and mix with the ricotta. Cut a pocket in each chicken breast and fill.
Layer the potatoes in a dish with most of the cream and bake at 180C.
Sear the chicken in oil, then roast at 200C alongside for the last 20 minutes.
Cook the mushrooms in butter, add the remaining cream and simmer until thick. Serve over the chicken.

veg.make_ahead: Gratin up to 1 day, reheat gently

steps.text: Layer the potatoes in a dish with most of the cream and bake at 180C.
Wilt the spinach, squeeze dry and mix with the ricotta and parmesan. Pull the stalks from the portobello mushrooms and fill the cups.
Brush the stuffed mushrooms with the oil and roast at 200C alongside for the last 15 minutes.
Cook the sliced mushrooms in the butter, add the remaining cream and simmer until thick. Serve over the stuffed mushrooms.
Mix the crushed biscuits with the butter and press into a tin.
Beat the cream cheese and sugar, then the eggs. Pour over the base.
Bake at 160C for 50 minutes, then cool in the oven. Chill until firm.
Spread with lemon curd before serving.
Blend the milk, ice cream, honey and cinnamon until thick and frothy.
Pour into eight small glasses. Cut a slit in each biscuit and perch one on each rim.
